findings.passage: Common-sense gun laws: Firearms are the number one cause of death for children and teens in America. Keeping our communities safe means advocating for and passing common-sense gun laws that ban assault weapons, implement comprehensive background checks, require safe storage, and keep guns out of the hands of domestic abusers. We must protect our children in the classroom, on the playground, and in houses of worship.
